_comment: Order partials the main sweep cannot reach, with the reason. The sweep composes against one kingdom's catalogue (ORK3_SWEEP_KINGDOM, default 1), so 'unreachable' here means unreachable from Scrollery/compose against that catalogue — not from every route. ScrollSweepCoverageTest requires each to be declared here rather than silently skipped.

reasons.hunter: hunter's award_id 6969 is Arcanyst's invention, not an ORK award id (system/lib/ork3/data/scroll-orders.php says so), so no row resolves to hunter BY ID. Archery resolves BY NAME instead: Scroll::OrderForAwardRow() matches ARCHERY_NAMES on rows whose award_id is 0 or Custom Award, so real archery grants DO reprint as hunter through Scrollery/render, and compose offers it in any kingdom whose catalogue carries such a row (kingdom 10 as 'Order of the Archer', kingdom 20 as 'Order of the Hunter' — combo150 drives it on kingdom 10). Kingdom 1, the sweep's default catalogue, carries none, so the main sweep cannot compose it. hunter/border.png is also live as a custom-recipe border and stage C sweeps that.
